impact: Feeds the memory-cycle worry that is already hitting MU, DRAM and SNXX, and the neocloud-bubble concern weighing on NBIS; the long-term demand view limits the damage.
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told about 50 Samsung presidents in an Oct. 31 closed-door session that some AI demand, particularly for memory chips and data centers, had been double-counted, Korea's Financial News reported on Nov. 11 from Q&A notes. He said only OpenAI and Anthropic were driving major demand growth, warned of short-term fluctuations and a possible supply shock, but expects AI demand to grow enormously over time. He did not say which demand was double-counted.
title: Altman told Samsung AI memory demand was 'double-counted'
